items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I went over there and he wanted to offer me $125.

ctx.x: Maybe sometime before you left for Harry James.

What's his name, too, Artie Shaw -- remember? He called me when we were living up on in New York -- he called me up once, and I wanted to know what he wanted, while he was playing one of those theatres on Broadway. I went over there and he wanted to offer me $125. I said, "I make more than that with Duke -- why should I leave him for that?"
What did he say? Did he bring up his offer any?
